scope: correct two object-identity errors in the CL_Init / CL_Shutdown model before counting CL_Init invocations

corrections.claim_before: cl+0xA8F0 holds an encoded pointer and the round-by-round repair wrote cl+0xA8F0

0x5B2C10_prologue: 0x5B2C32 xor eax,0xD362501F   ; eax = cl, kept at [ebp-0x83c]
CL_Init_writer: 0x5C864E ja 0x5C899E            ; jump table at 0x5C8A4C indexed by edi

corrections.conclusion: 0xA8F0 belongs to cl2 (the 0xAA10 block decoded from [0x76638F4]), not to cl. Every previous 'repair cl+0xA8F0' wrote the wrong object; its 'crash moved forward' observation cannot be used as evidence that the repair was correct.
corrections.correction: repair cl2+0xA8F0 = alloc(0x180) ^ 0x96B9DC91; only write cl2+0xA8DC=0x1F and cl2+0xA8D8=0x20 when they are still zero

corrections.claim_before: both stores to [0x331C0C8] (0x5C85C0 and 0x5C8AC1) are inside CL_Init

independent_routine: 0x5C8A84..0x5C8AC0 clear a batch of globals including [0x76638F4] and [0x331C0C8]

corrections.conclusion: The second store starts at 0x5C8AC0 (not 0x5C8AC1) and belongs to an independent teardown routine at 0x5C8A70, provisionally CL_Shutdown. CL_Init ends at 0x5C8A39. So cl is created only by CL_Init and destroyed only by 0x5C8A70.

evidence: 0x5C83EB jg 0x5C8A29          ; already initialised -> straight to the epilogue
corrections.conclusion: A second CL_Init call returns immediately unless 0x5C8A70 ran first. Therefore any real cl re-creation implies a shutdown-then-init sequence, and a counter at 0x5C85BF (the allocation store) is the decisive signal, while a counter at 0x5C83D0 only measures entries.

official_reset_sequences.0x4FE774: call 0x5C8A70 (teardown); push 1; call 0x5C83D0 (CL_Init mode 1); then set several globals
official_reset_sequences.0x813D11: call 0x5C8A70 (teardown); eax = 3 or 7 depending on [ebp+8]; push eax; call 0x5C83D0; mov [0x76446B0],7
official_reset_sequences.note: 0x813D11 is the only located sequence that both rebuilds the client objects and writes the phase value 7 that 0x5B2C10 requires (cmp edx,7). It is the natural candidate for a positive 'enter loading' path.
